root.label: Florida family plane goes missing near Bahamas

events.label: Florida family plane goes missing near Bahamas

slots.name: people aboard
slots.sentence: A small plane carrying four family members flying back home to Florida went missing off the Bahamas on Monday, the U.S. Coast Guard and authorities in the Bahamas said.

slots.name: aircraft seats
slots.sentence: Bahamas police identified the plane as a PA-34 Piper five-seater aircraft, with tail number N212ML.

slots.name: contact distance
slots.sentence: It said it departed Great Harbour Cay, a city in the Berry Islands of the Bahamas.

slots.name: search status
slots.sentence: The search had to be suspended due to bad weather, Bahamas police said.

slots.name: last contact distance
slots.sentence: Air traffic control lost contact with the aircraft when it was about 13 miles west of Andros Island, Bahamas police said.

slots.name: coast guard contact time
slots.sentence: Bahamian officials contacted the U.S. Coast Guard at about 2 p.m. and requested assistance finding a downed plane, a spokesperson said.
